title: Desk Guidance — Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions and the Building's Other Cover
content:
# The Subscription and the Building's Other Cover

Desk guidance on how a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions reads the other contracts standing at the same building.

## Rule

The subscription reads the rest of the building's cover before it prices or measures anything. Where the site's data is drawn from the controls system under an active automation service plan, the point licence is carried on that plan and this subscription charges nothing per point for the same points; where there is no such plan, the subscription carries its own gateway and per-meter fees. Where a retrofit project at the same building reaches completion and the tier resets the baseline on retrofit, the baseline is reset from the project's completion date and the guarantee for the part year is prorated, because measuring new equipment against old use would credit the company with savings it did not manage. A site whose only cover is a demand service rate program may hold the entry tier, which needs no meters, but no tier above it, because those tiers read data the building does not produce. Fault findings from this subscription are worked under the maintenance agreement where the unit is covered, and the analyst hours of this subscription are never spent performing mechanical work. Whether the tier resets its baseline on retrofit and the tier's gateway fee are the figures fixed for the tier.

## By contract at the building

| Other cover at the building | Bearing on the subscription |
|---|---|
| An active plan under Building Automation Service Plans feeding the subscription's data from the controls system | the point licence sits on that plan; nothing is charged per point here for the same points |
| No such plan | the subscription carries its own gateway and per-meter fees |
| A project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects reaching completion, at a tier that resets on retrofit | the baseline is reset from the project's completion date; the part-year guarantee is prorated |
| Only a program under Demand Service Rate Programs | the Utility Bill Tracking Subscription may be held; no tier above it |
| A unit covered under Preventive Maintenance Agreements | a fault finding on that unit is worked under that agreement |

## Record the retrofit reading rests on

Whether a retrofit project at the same building has reached completion, and on what date, is read from the company's project records for that site — the project's status and its completion date — before any savings are verified; the owner's description of the works does not stand in for the record.

## Points of judgement

- Analyst hours are analysis. They are never spent performing mechanical work, whatever the owner asks.
- The entry tier needs no meters, which is why a building with only a demand service rate program may hold it.
